    16  /-!
    17  # Model categories
    18  
    19  We introduce a typeclass `ModelCategory C` expressing that `C` is equipped with
    20  classes of morphisms named "fibrations", "cofibrations" and "weak equivalences"
    21  which satisfy the axioms of (closed) model categories as they appear for example
    22  in *Simplicial Homotopy Theory* by Goerss and Jardine. We also provide an
    23  alternate constructor `ModelCategory.mk'` which uses a formulation of the axioms
    24  using weak factorization systems.
    25  
    26  As a given category `C` may have several model category structures, it is advisable
    27  to define only local instances of `ModelCategory`, or to set these instances on type synonyms.
    28  
    29  ## References
    30  * [Daniel G. Quillen, Homotopical algebra][Quillen1967]
    31  * [Paul G. Goerss, John F. Jardine, Simplicial Homotopy Theory][goerss-jardine-2009]
    32  * https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/model+category
    33  
    34  -/
    35  
    36  @[expose] public section
    37  
    38  universe w v u
    39  
    40  namespace HomotopicalAlgebra
    41  
    42  open CategoryTheory Limits
    43  
    44  variable (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C]
    45  
    46  /-- A model category is a category equipped with classes of morphisms named cofibrations,
    47  fibrations and weak equivalences which satisfy the axioms CM1/CM2/CM3/CM4/CM5
    48  of (closed) model categories. -/
    49  class ModelCategory where
    50    categoryWithFibrations : CategoryWithFibrations C := by infer_instance
    51    categoryWithCofibrations : CategoryWithCofibrations C := by infer_instance
    52    categoryWithWeakEquivalences : CategoryWithWeakEquivalences C := by infer_instance
    53    cm1a : HasFiniteLimits C := by infer_instance
    54    cm1b : HasFiniteColimits C := by infer_instance
    55    cm2 : (weakEquivalences C).HasTwoOutOfThreeProperty := by infer_instance
    56    cm3a : (weakEquivalences C).IsStableUnderRetracts := by infer_instance
    57    cm3b : (fibrations C).IsStableUnderRetracts := by infer_instance
    58    cm3c : (cofibrations C).IsStableUnderRetracts := by infer_instance
    59    cm4a {A B X Y : C} (i : A ⟶ B) (p : X ⟶ Y) [Cofibration i] [WeakEquivalence i] [Fibration p] :
    60        HasLiftingProperty i p := by intros; infer_instance
    61    cm4b {A B X Y : C} (i : A ⟶ B) (p : X ⟶ Y) [Cofibration i] [Fibration p] [WeakEquivalence p] :
    62        HasLiftingProperty i p := by intros; infer_instance
    63    cm5a : MorphismProperty.HasFactorization (trivialCofibrations C) (fibrations C) := by
    64      infer_instance
    65    cm5b : MorphismProperty.HasFactorization (cofibrations C) (trivialFibrations C) := by
    66      infer_instance
